verdict.rationale: vLLM ships a CLI that starts its OpenAI-compatible API server, a benchmarking CLI, offline inference, and an official Docker image, so it can run headlessly without any UI. However, nothing in the pack documents CI usage or automation workflows specifically. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration docs or examples, documented non-interactive automation guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Starts the vLLM OpenAI Compatible API server.
vLLM offers an official Docker image for deployment. The image can be used to run OpenAI compatible server and is available on Docker Hub as vllm/vllm-openai
Run benchmark tests for latency online serving throughput and offline inference throughput.
simply set `trust_remote_code=True` for offline-inference or `--trust-remote-code` for the online serving.
